brand.name: RH11

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use deep obsidian #0A0A0A with 1px border strokes.
Red accent (#8E0D1A) must be used with tactical restraint: only for primary CTA buttons, active size tags, micro-badges and indicators.
Never use pure white backgrounds or generic soft pastel cards.

products_data.name: Sudadera RH11 Heavyweight Hood
products_data.short_description: Capucha envolvente sin cordones visibles, bolsillo canguro oculto y corte oversize atlético fabricado en algodón denso peinado.
products_data.full_description: La sudadera definitiva de entrenamiento y calle. Diseñada con un peso estructural de 420 GSM que mantiene su caída limpia sesión tras sesión. Doble puño elástico, interior afelpado térmico de tacto sedoso y remates termosellados.

specs.origen: Confeccionado en Portugal / Tintado en España
specs.lavado: Lavar en frío a 30°C. No usar secadora. Planchar del revés.

products_data.name: Camiseta RH11 Tactical Boxy Tee
products_data.short_description: Cuello cerrado de 3 cm reforzado, hombro caído y acabado texturizado matte. La base perfecta para tu día a día de alto rendimiento.
products_data.full_description: Construida para resistir el roce y mantener un porte intachable. El grosor de 240 GSM proporciona una silueta limpia sin transparencias. Transpirable, con costuras planas anti-rozaduras para levantamientos y uso diario.

specs.lavado: Lavar en frío a 30°C. Secado al aire recomendado.

endpoints.create_order: POST /api/orders (body: customer info, items, total, status: 'confirmed')

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use pure obsidian #0A0A0A base with razor-thin white/10 borders.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Accent color #8E0D1A (dark athletic red) is reserved solely for primary buttons, active tags, and strategic accents. Do not saturate the background with red.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Navigation bar must be sticky/fixed with heavy backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#0A0A0A]/85, never fully transparent.

Both products ('Camiseta' and 'Sudadera') must have full interactive detail views with gallery zoom, size buttons (XS to XXL), color selectors, quantity, size guide, materials & care accordion, and add-to-cart.
Cart drawer must support full order checkout that persists order data into the database/API without third-party payment gateway.
Use sonner for toast feedback on cart operations.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
